decisions.state_note: o000: visible window x146–209, y118–181 shows a thick dark fragment along its left side, with a curved right contour near x177 and white to the right; fragment is cropped above, below, and left. No detections.

o001: window x114–177, y118–181 shows a thick dark right-side curve around a white recess opening left near y148; dark portions extend through the top, left, and bottom crop edges. No detections. Digit remains uncertain.

o002: window x114–177, y86–149 shows a thick dark band sloping down-right from the left edge near y112 toward the right edge near y140, with white above and below its left portion. No detections; both ends are cropped.
o003: window x82–145, y86–149 shows a thick dark band sloping down-right across the window, with white above and below; both ends are cropped. No detections. Upper-left continuation remains unknown.

o004: window x82–145, y54–117 shows white recess opening right, with a rounded left contour near (90,81) and dark above, left, and below. Dark lower edge slopes down-right. No detections; outer contours remain cropped.

o005: window x82–145, y22–85 shows a dark upper band near y32–60, rising from a thicker left portion; white lies above and below its right portion. Detector reports horizontal and rising-right bands. Right continuation is cropped; 5 and 8 remain hypotheses.

o006: window x114–177, y22–85 shows a thick near-horizontal dark band around y32–60, with white above and below. Detector agrees on horizontal orientation. Both lateral continuations are cropped; right endpoint remains unknown.

o007: window x146–209, y22–85 shows the upper dark band ending in a rounded right cap near (193,46), with white beyond and below. Detector supports a horizontal segment. This favors 5; lower structure remains incomplete.

o008: window x146–209, y54–117 is mostly white, with dark fragments at the upper-left and lower-left edges; no upright connection is visible in this window. No detections. Lower digit structure remains incomplete.

o009: window x146–209, y86–149 shows a dark fragment entering from the left near y111 and broadening to a curved right contour near x177 at the bottom crop; white above and right. No detections. Lower continuation remains unknown.

o010: window x146–209, y118–181 shows the same thick right-side curve seen in o000, with right contour near x177 and a small white recess at the left edge near y151. No detections; bottom remains cropped. Digit 5 remains a hypothesis.

o011: window x146–209, y150–213 shows dark at upper-left with its right contour curving down-left from about (177,157) to the left crop near y192; white below and right. No detections. Lower-left continuation remains unknown; 5 remains the leading hypothesis.

o012: window x114–177, y150–213 shows a thick lower band rising right, with white below and a white recess above-left. Detector labels its left portion horizontal. Combined with the upper capped bar and middle/right curve in prior observations, this supports digit 5.
